title: MCP refill_batch Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `refill_batch` tool response, built by `_serialize_refill_result`. U10 (R12, KTD5): a background refill — the same laddered batch shape `batch-result.schema.json` (fetch_batch) declares, wrapped in a null/signal/supersede envelope. `batch` is null with signal="no_further_items" when the freshly planned batch came back with zero new items (R13); otherwise `batch` is populated and `signal` is null. `supersede` (KTD5) is set on every response regardless of whether new items were found. The nested item/policy shapes below intentionally duplicate batch-result.schema.json's own $defs (no cross-file $ref in this schema house style) rather than referencing that file.

instance.description: The full rendered item instance verbatim (KD6) — see schemas/item-instance.schema.json.

batch.description: The freshly planned batch, or null exactly when signal is "no_further_items".

signal.description: KTD7's taxonomy: null in the ordinary case, "no_further_items" (R13) when the pool for this skill (seen union delivered) is fully consumed.

supersede.description: KTD5: true when the plan for skill_id materially changed since the client's last batch (now certified at/above serving ceiling, or a remediation dose now queued) — set on every response regardless of signal.
